raw_text: Has anyone seen this video of an IAF pilot supposedly criticizing the government? Just appeared on my timeline from Pakistani accounts. The lip sync looks really off to me. Posting here for verification. UPDATE: Multiple OSINT accounts have confirmed this is AI-generated. The background is from 2019, facial artefacts visible around the jaw. Classic ISPR information operation before Indian elections. They tried something similar in 2019 post-Balakot.
